steps.title: Open Slop PDF. Nothing is uploaded, and the file never leaves your device.
Open a page and zoom in
Select a line of text and press Highlight
Edit text: double-click a word, type a new one, press Enter
Open the Fonts panel from the top bar
Open Convert: Word, Excel and PowerPoint
Organize: drag a page to a new position
Redact a word: Redact in the selection bar, then Apply redactions
